description:
The Key Account Director leads the New Logo Sales motion within the sales organization. This role drives bookings growth by acquiring new customers, prospecting to non-MeridianLink credit unions and community banks with company-provided tools and processes. The Key Account Director builds a qualified pipeline of 3 to 4 times the assigned quota and moves opportunities through defined stages to contracted/won. The role also maintains the territory infrastructure needed to hit that goal.

Expected Duties

· Deliver bookings revenue against defined quarterly and annual quotas.

· Coordinate and manage complex customer RFPs from start to finish.

· Build and execute territory development strategies to grow accounts, partner relationships, and association relationships within a set geographic area.

· Work directly with prospect executives, buying committees, third-party consultants, and partners.

· Serve as the subject matter expert on the evaluation and selection process, guiding buyers and assembling internal partners for technical, security, functional, and deployment discussions.

· Partner with cross-functional teams to advance shared MeridianLink goals.

· Increase visibility and business development in the assigned territory.

Qualifications

Knowledge, skills, and abilities

· Works on new, highly complex, or high-impact business problems. Has complete knowledge of the area of specialization and its principles and practices, and works independently with sound judgment.

· Engages in strategic dialogue with C-level executives, VPs, Directors, and Associates at target markets: credit unions and community banks.

· Advises prospects on challenges, best practices, and solutions that improve the performance of their origination programs.

· Assesses unusual circumstances and applies sophisticated analytical and problem-solving techniques to advance opportunities and projects.

· Solves unexpected problems creatively and guides them across a broad team of internal partners.

· Leads a small team of internal partners who support territory strategy and the teams that deliver opportunities and projects.

Education and experience

· Bachelor's degree, or 5 to 10 years of related experience and/or equivalent work experience.

Travel

Up to 25% travel.
